max_tire.note: 265/60R18 (about 30.5 in) fits with no problems, including off-road. Owners warn against 265/65R18, which can rub when the air suspension drops. 275/55R20 clears the bump stops but rubs the liners at full lock. Check that a taller spare still fits the well.

items.title: Front differential coupling / propshaft spline wear
items.summary: The front diff coupling sleeve and propshaft may be misaligned and wear the splines, causing noise and vibration. Land Rover recalled 19,168 trucks.

items.title: Transmission parking pawl guide plate
items.summary: Some trucks were built with an incorrectly made parking-pawl guide plate.

items.title: Front brake hose rupture
items.summary: One or both flexible front brake hoses may rupture and lose brake fluid (built 15 April 2005 to 4 September 2012).

items.title: Takata passenger airbag inflator (Zone A)
items.summary: Passenger frontal airbag inflator replacement, prioritised by state of registration.

items.title: Takata passenger airbag inflator (expansion)
items.summary: Further Takata inflator replacements by zone; see also 18V-011 and 18V-015.

items.title: Occupant classification system
items.summary: An OCS fault can light the airbag warning and disable the passenger airbag.

items.title: Windshield installation
items.summary: Windshields may have been installed incorrectly at the factory.

timeline.change: Launched in early 2002 as a 2003 model in North America. First monocoque Range Rover, with four-corner independent air suspension, BMW M62 4.4 V8 (and M57 Td6 diesel elsewhere), and a ZF five-speed auto.
BMW-engined trucks. The nylon timing-chain guides go brittle, so buy only with receipts or plan to replace them. The 2003–05 front-diff coupling recall also applies.
Facelift. Jaguar AJ-V8 4.4 (305 PS) and 4.2 supercharged (400 PS) replace the BMW V8, with ZF six-speed autos and a new touchscreen infotainment system.

Terrain Response, a locking centre diff, an electronic rear diff (standard on Supercharged, optional elsewhere), Brembo brakes and an electronic handbrake. The 3.6 TDV8 replaces the Td6 outside the US, and the switchblade key arrives mid-year.
Facelift. 5.0 V8 (375 PS) and 5.0 supercharged (510 PS), LED-accented headlights, and a 12-in TFT virtual instrument panel. Check that the chain tensioners and guides have been updated.
4.4 TDV8 with ZF 8HP70 eight-speed (non-US); reclining rear seats.
Final year. The L405 is unveiled at the Paris show.

identify.intro: Over 10 years the L322 changed engines twice and its 4x4 hardware once, and those changes decide what the truck needs and what it's worth.

items.head: Engine era
items.body: 2003–05 US trucks have BMW's M62 4.4. For 2006–09 it's Jaguar's AJ-V8, as a 4.4 or a 4.2 supercharged. 2010–12 trucks have the 5.0 or 5.0 supercharged. The diesels (Td6, 3.6 TDV8, 4.4 TDV8) were never sold in the US.

items.head: 4x4 hardware
items.body: Before 2007 the truck has a Torsen centre diff and no Terrain Response. From 2007 it has Terrain Response, a locking centre diff and an electronic rear diff (standard on Supercharged, optional on others).

items.head: 2010 facelift tells
items.body: LED-accented bi-xenon headlights, LED tail lights with a three-bar design, fog lights moved lower in the bumper, and a 12-in TFT virtual instrument panel instead of analogue gauges.

items.head: Key
items.body: Around January 2007 production the BMW-style key gave way to Land Rover's sealed 'switchblade' key, which recharges from a coil in the ignition switch.

items.head: Holland & Holland
items.body: Not an official Land Rover limited edition. Overfinch built them from standard trucks, on the 4.4 TDV8 or 5.0 supercharged, with a gun box, a drinks cabinet and the 'Aero 3' body kit.

values.intro: This is where cheap Range Rovers live. Most sell for less than a set of air struts and a timing job together, and only very low-mile, well-documented trucks earn more.
values.note: Based on 22 Bring a Trailer sales from late August to October 2026 ($7,500–$45,000, median about $14,600). Sub-50k-mile trucks dominate the top band; one exceptional 2011 HSE at $45,000 was an outlier.

production.intro: Built at Solihull from 2001 to 2012. It was developed as the 'L30' under BMW and renamed L322 after Ford bought Land Rover.

editions.name: 20th Anniversary Edition (North America)
editions.note: 40 built, all Supercharged, in a special pearl white with 20-in 'Diamond' wheels; one per dealer, allocated by lottery.

editions.name: 35th Anniversary Edition (UK)
editions.note: 30 built in Claret with a two-tone interior, on the 4.2 supercharged.

editions.name: 40th Anniversary Autobiography Black
editions.note: 700 built in Barolo Black, with a different grille.

editions.name: Autobiography Ultimate Edition
editions.note: 500 built, with rear-seat iPads, a refrigerator and electric reclining climate-controlled rear seats.
